latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Video Subtitle Generator.

- Allows users to upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB for AI-powered subtitle generation and burned-in captions.
- Processes requests on cloud GPUs, delivering 1080p MP4 files in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatically handles authentication and session creation with free credits for new users.
- Supports essential commands: upload, generate/edit subtitles, check credits, view status, and export/download.
- Provides clear user feedback, robust error handling, and tips for optimal results.
- Compatible with a variety of video and audio formats for export.
